package.name: astral_pim_ik
package.description: PiM-IK-style two-stage inverse kinematics for the Astral arm: a neural network predicts the arm angle psi from the end-effector pose, then the DH-free geometric closed-form IK (astral_arm_teleop.ik.geometric) resolves the 7 joints. Standalone library + tests; no ROS node.
